executionContext.overlapNote: Memory C31/C63 on CPUs 4-7; C39 gates on CPUs 0-3; API fix on CPUs 8-11; C55 fix on CPUs 12-15. Latency is contended and observational only.
executionContext.latencyInterpretation: Latency is observational under concurrent campaign lanes and is not adoption performance evidence.

rules.processMemory: Node process RSS endpoints, sampled operation peak, and process-lifetime high-water mark; Git child RSS is not added
rules.cacheBytes: Explicit Core byte counters plus labeled shallow payload estimates; never equated with process RSS

cohortCaps.note: Each worker and its Git subprocesses inherit per-process RLIMIT_AS/CPU limits; this is not an aggregate cgroup memory cap.
